page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g6.26xlarge is a general-purpose server instance powered by x86_64 Intel Xeon 8269CY processors running at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. Utilizing KVM hypervisor architecture, the instance provides 104 dedicated vCPUs alongside 384 GB of system RAM, yielding a balanced ratio of approximately 3.69 GB of memory per core. It includes no local disk storage or GPU acceleration hardware, depending entirely on attached network block storage for persistent OS and data storage.

Networking capabilities feature a 25 Gbps baseline network bandwidth to support consistent network throughput across cloud infrastructure services. The server offers high resource density within a balanced compute-to-memory profile, rendering it qualitatively cost-efficient for large enterprise applications that do not require dedicated local SSD storage or GPU processing. Alibaba Cloud ecs.g6.26xlarge is suitable for multi-threaded backend applications, relational databases, distributed caching nodes, batch processing tasks, and scaled web service deployments.
